Kit summary

Green Loong's Triple SlashBasicExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 4% of self Max HP each to a single enemy and inflicts 1 layer of [Celestial Might] (reduces all DMG dealt by 5%, up to 8 layers, this effect cannot be removed) and 1 layer of [Loong's Wrath] (cannot be stacked with [HP Burning], its DMG dealt is considered as [HP Burning] DMG) on the target. If the target has at least 1 layer of [Celestial Might] before Guan Yu casts Green Loong's Triple Slash, he has a 50% chance to cast Green Loong's Triple Slash to pursue and attack once.
Green Loong Crescent Blade Lv.1At the beginning of any ally's turns, Guan Yu will inflict 1 layer of [Celestial Might] on all enemies if he survives. Guan Yu gains 20% DMG RES. Each time Guan Yu casts Green Loong's Triple Slash or uses Green Loong's Triple Slash to pursue and attack, he gains a [Shield] equal to 20% of self Max HP (up to 200% of self Max HP) and increases his DMG dealt to Boss by 50% (up to 500%). Guan Yu gains 1 layer of [Advancing March] (up to 5 layers) when allies (excluding self) pursue and attack. When [Advancing March] is stacked to 5 layers, Guan Yu consumes all of them to order all allies (excluding self) to launch basic attacks to pursue and attack a random enemy once immediately. Pursue-and-attacks triggered through this effect will not grant Guan Yu [Advancing March].
Green Loong Crescent Blade Lv.3Guan Yu gains [Divine Manifestation] for 2 turns and 5 layers of [Advancing March] after he casts Green Loong's Triple Slash to pursue and attack 5 times. [Divine Manifestation]: Increases all allies' Basic Attack DMG and pursue-and-attack DMG dealt by using basic attacks by 100%. At the end of an enemy's turns, restores all allies' HP equal to the enemy's owned layers of [Celestial Might] x5000. At the beginning of each wave, Guan Yu is immune to all Turn Meter Reduction effects. Besides, Guan Yu casts Unmatched Fortitude and Sky-Cleaving Fury once immediately and gains 1000 extra SPD for 3 turns. Meanwhile, inflicts [Cowardice] on the enemy with the highest SPD for 3 turns. [Cowardice]: Cannot gain any [Shield] and reduces the Turn Meter bonus effect granted to allies by 80%. If the owner is a Blue Mark Hero, whenever they increase more than 10% Turn Meter for an ally, deducts the ally's Max HP by 8% 10 times. In the duration of [Cowardice], the owner cannot revive after being killed. When 2 or more enemies with the [Resonance] tag are deployed, increases all allies' Max HP by 300%.
Unmatched FortitudeActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 2 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 16% of self Max HP each to all enemies; if the target has at least 2 layers of [Celestial Might], inflicts [Deep HP Burning II] and 2 layers of [Loong's Wrath] on them for 2 turns. Self gains 2 layers of [DMG Immunity] and 1 layer of [Taunt] for 2 turns. [Taunt] granted by this effect cannot be removed. In the duration of [Taunt]: Each time self is hit by enemies' basic attacks, self has a 100% chance to order a random ally to launch basic attacks to pursue and attack the attacker once.

Virtue's ZenithPassiveExclusive Lv.2
At the beginning of self turns, increases Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG based on self current DMG RES: Every 1% DMG RES increases Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG by 2.5%, up to 100% can be gained through this effect. After casting skills proactively each time, inflicts 1 layer of [Celestial Might] on all enemies for 2 turns. When an ally (excluding self) launches basic attacks to enemies with [Celestial Might], the ally has a 50% chance to launch basic attacks to pursue and attack once. Increases all allies' Max HP by 15%. At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Divine Ward] (during which each stage of the DMG taken by the owner cannot exceed 25% of the owner's Max HP) for 2 turns.
Green Loong Crescent Blade Lv.2Each time an ally (excluding Guan Yu) launches basic attacks or uses basic attacks to pursue and attack, they gain a [Shield] equal to 15% of Guan Yu's Max HP, up to 10 layers. Each time an ally launches basic attacks or uses basic attacks to pursue and attack, they gain 1 layer of [Righteousness] (increases Effect RES by 4% and Mastery RES by 6%, up to 10 layers.) Each time the ally with max layers of [Righteousness] casts skills proactively, additionally deals [HP Burning] DMG by 50% of Guan Yu's Max HP to the main target.
Sky-Cleaving FuryActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals [HP Burning] DMG by 48% of self Max HP to a single enemy. Afterward, deals [HP Burning] DMG by 21% of self Max HP to all enemies and inflicts [Cold II] on them for 2 turns. Finally, deals [HP Burning] DMG by 21% of self Max HP to all enemies and inflicts 2 layers of [Loong's Wrath] for 2 turns. Meanwhile, grants all allies a [Shield] equal to 200% of self Max HP; this [Shield] cannot be removed.
